text: Params w d k t, a valid set of parameters for the debate protocol, stores Vera's failure probability v, Alice's probability goal c (honest Alice's claimed probabilities are usually off by <= c), Vera's acceptance goal s (Vera usually accepts if probabilities are off by <= s), Vera's rejection goal b (Vera usually rejects if probabilities are off by >= b), and Alice's and Bob's failure probability q. It requires 0 < k, 0 < c, c < s, s < b, 0 < q <= 1, 0 < v <= 1, q <= v and k*b <= w, together with the inequality sufficient for completeness d <= (1-v)*(w - k*c - q*(t+1)) and the inequality sufficient for soundness d <= (1-v)*(1 - q*(t+1))*(w - k*b).
title: General admissible parameters
